title: [YouPass Collect] - Community Center Changes Over A Decade
prompt: The maps below show the changes to a community center in 10 years' time. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The maps illustrate the layout of a community center at two points in time: a decade ago and at present.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the community center has undergone significant redevelopment, with a notable shift from office and garden spaces towards recreational and social facilities. While the central hall, entrance area, and car park remained unchanged, several rooms were repurposed or relocated to accommodate new functions.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding the major transformations, the garden in the northwest corner was converted into an indoor sports facility, providing residents with year-round exercise opportunities. Similarly, the eastern side of the building experienced substantial changes, as the four offices that previously occupied this area were replaced by an expansive cafe area, which incorporated the former coffee bar space. Additionally, the toilets were relocated from their original position on the east side to a new location north of the hall, adjacent to the storage room.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for the remaining modifications, the kitchen in the southeast was reduced in size to make way for a new single office, which now sits directly south of the entrance. Meanwhile, several key features retained their original positions and functions throughout the period: the car park on the west side, the central hall accommodating 100 seats, and the entrance area with its reception desk and cloakroom all remained unaltered, maintaining continuity in the center's core infrastructure.
